first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.detail: Second pass after the independent and gap audits. FTTS no longer carries Method content once the patches are applied: the stale draw-rate [cagey x second_leg] interaction and the pace_press interaction are dropped (so integrate re-adds the first-scorer wording), soc.knockout_cagey_factor is detached and re-attached as a FTTS-specific secondary input, soc.pace_press/shots/xg are detached, and the retired winning-margin and method-tree definitions are removed from new_inputs; the two earlier Method interactions stay dropped and are re-homed in the knockout record. The UEFA Super Cup extra-time assertion is replaced by an explicit UNVERIFIED gap (extra_time_rules_unverified). Duplicate flags: tie_advancement_state_tree and european_slot_spillover are rebutted in part by narrowing their definitions (input_audit/SOCCER_zblk.json); the catalog audit_flag fields still read DUPLICATE until the orchestrator regenerates them. Status holds only if integrate/apply_archetype_patches are run in that order; I could not run them.
